name: app-three-pale-blue-health-screens-with-side-descriptions-on-plinths
title: Three Health Screens on Plinths with Descriptions
whatItIs: A pale page of three rounded panels, each with a numbered caption and a phone on a grey plinth or ledge: onboarding, health history and profile & settings, with the phone tilted differently in each.
whatItMeans: Varying the tilt and prop in each panel keeps a repetitive sequence lively, and short captions explain each screen.
techniques: One panel per screen with a numbered caption
Different plinth and rock props per panel
Soft blue gradient inside each panel
Phone tilted at a new angle each time

vocabulary.definition: A rounded panel presenting one screen with a caption.
Text and image swapping sides down the page.
Changing the scene object to keep repeated shots fresh.
